Please provide: 1. CURRENT STEAM AWARDS LANDSCAPE (December 2024): - Recent Steam Awards winners and nominees - Top-rated games on Steam currently - Games with recent awards or recognition (Game of the Year, best in genre, etc.) - Community-voted awards and trending games 2. TOP 3 GAME RECOMMENDATIONS FOR DECEMBER 2024: For each game, provide: - Game title - Why it's recommended (considering genre diversity, replay value, December gaming suitability) - Estimated playtime (hours) - Current price (USD) - Key features and awards received - Whether it's better for holiday break gaming (long single-player vs quick multiplayer sessions) Format your response as a structured report with clear sections. Be specific about actual games and their current status in December 2024. Consider that December is holiday season, so factor in games suitable for longer gaming sessions during breaks.""" print("📡 Querying LLM for Steam game awards and recommendations...") response = provider.complete(research_prompt, max_tokens=4096) print("✅ Research data received from LLM") # Create PDF report current_time = datetime.now() timestamp_filename = current_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S") timestamp_display = current_time.strftime("%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p") # Get desktop path desktop_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" pdf_filename = f"Steam_Game_Report_{timestamp_filename}.pdf" pdf_path = desktop_path / pdf_filename print(f"📄 Creating PDF report: {pdf_filename}") # Detect headings (lines with all caps or starting with numbers) if line.isupper() or (len(line) > 0 and line[0].isdigit() and '.' in line[:3]): if current_section: elements.append(Spacer(1, 0.15*inch)) elements.append(Paragraph(line, heading_style)) current_section = [] elif line.startswith('-') or line.startswith('•'): # Bullet points clean_line = line.lstrip('-•').strip() elements.append(Paragraph(f"• {clean_line}", body_style)) elif ':' in line and len(line.split(':')[0]) < 50: # Key-value pairs (like "Price: $XX") elements.append(Paragraph(f"{line.split(':')[0]}: {':'.join(line.split(':')[1:])}", body_style)) else: # Regular paragraph elements.append(Paragraph(line, body_style)) print("💾 Building PDF document...") # Build PDF doc.build(elements) print(f"✅ PDF report created successfully: {pdf_path}") # Save metadata print("📊 Saving metadata...") learnings_dir = Path(os.environ.get('RAVL_LEARNINGS_DIR', '.')) metadata_dir = learnings_dir / 'state' metadata_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) metadata = { 'timestamp': current_time.isoformat(), 'pdf_filename': pdf_filename, 'pdf_path': str(pdf_path), 'report_generated': True, 'games_recommended': 3, 'execution_date': current_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") } metadata_file = metadata_dir / 'metadata.json' with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f: json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2) print(f"✅ Metadata saved to: {metadata_file}") # Also save raw research data awards_dir = Path('awards') awards_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) research_data = { 'timestamp': current_time.isoformat(), 'research_content': response, 'report_filename': pdf_filename, 'record_count': 1, 'data_changed': True } awards_file = awards_dir / 'steam_awards_research.json' with open(awards_file, 'w') as f: json.dump(research_data, f, indent=2) print(f"✅ Research data saved to: {awards_file}") print(f"\n🎉 Complete! PDF report available at: {pdf_path}")

import os import json from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path from ravl.common.llm.llm_providers import LLMProviderFactory from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle from reportlab.lib.units import inch from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER, TA_JUSTIFY # Get current date and time for filename and report current_datetime = datetime.now() date_time_str = current_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M") formatted_datetime = current_datetime.strftime("%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p") # Define output path on desktop desktop_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" output_filename = f"steam_game_report_{date_time_str}.pdf" output_path = desktop_path / output_filename print(f"🎮 Starting Steam Game Awards Report Generation") print(f"📅 Report Date: {formatted_datetime}") print(f"💾 Output: {output_path}") # Initialize LLM provider print("\n🤖 Initializing LLM provider...") provider = LLMProviderFactory.create_provider("anthropic") # Step 1: Research current Steam game awards print("\n🔍 Researching current Steam Game Awards...") awards_prompt = """Research and provide comprehensive information about the current Steam Game Awards. Include: 1. The most recent Steam Awards ceremony (2023 or 2024) 2. Major award categories and winners 3. Notable nominees that didn't win but are highly regarded 4. Any ongoing voting or upcoming awards Format your response as a detailed summary suitable for a professional report.""" awards_response = provider.complete(awards_prompt, max_tokens=4096) print("✅ Steam Awards research completed") # Step 2: Identify top 3 games to recommend print("\n🎯 Identifying top 3 game recommendations for December play...") recommendations_prompt = """Based on current Steam Awards information, popular Steam games, and what makes a game great for December holiday play, identify the TOP 3 games to recommend for purchase and play in December. For each game, provide: 1. Game title 2. Why it won or was nominated for Steam Awards 3. Detailed advice on why it's a great December purchase, considering: - Gameplay length and replayability - Multiplayer/co-op features for holiday gaming with friends/family - Recent updates or seasonal content - Community activity and player base - Value for money - Relaxing vs. engaging gameplay for holiday breaks - Any holiday-themed content or events Format as JSON with this structure: { "games": [ { "title": "Game Name", "awards_info": "Award wins/nominations", "december_advice": "Detailed advice paragraph" } ] }""" recommendations_response = provider.complete(recommendations_prompt, max_tokens=8192) print("✅ Game recommendations generated") # Parse the recommendations try: # Extract JSON from response json_start = recommendations_response.find('{') json_end = recommendations_response.rfind('}') + 1 recommendations_json = recommendations_response[json_start:json_end] recommendations_data = json.loads(recommendations_json) games = recommendations_data.get('games', [])[:3] # Ensure exactly 3 games print(f"✅ Parsed {len(games)} game recommendations") except Exception as e: print(f"⚠️ JSON parsing failed, using structured prompt...") # Fallback: request structured data more explicitly fallback_prompt = """Provide exactly 3 game recommendations as a simple list: GAME 1: Title: [title] Awards: [awards info] Advice: [why good for December] GAME 2: Title: [title] Awards: [awards info] Advice: [why good for December] GAME 3: Title: [title] Awards: [awards info] Advice: [why good for December]""" fallback_response = provider.complete(fallback_prompt, max_tokens=6144) # Parse the structured text response games = [] sections = fallback_response.split('GAME ') for section in sections[1:4]: # Get games 1, 2, 3 lines = section.strip().split('\n') game = {} for line in lines: if line.startswith('Title:'): game['title'] = line.replace('Title:', '').strip() elif line.startswith('Awards:'): game['awards_info'] = line.replace('Awards:', '').strip() elif line.startswith('Advice:'): game['december_advice'] = line.replace('Advice:', '').strip() if game: games.append(game) print(f"✅ Parsed {len(games)} game recommendations from structured format") # Step 3: Create PDF report print("\n📄 Generating PDF report...") # Create PDF document doc = SimpleDocTemplate( str(output_path), pagesize=letter, rightMargin=0.75*inch, leftMargin=0.75*inch, topMargin=1*inch, bottomMargin=0.75*inch ) # Define styles styles = getSampleStyleSheet() title_style = ParagraphStyle( 'CustomTitle', parent=styles['Heading1'], fontSize=24, textColor='#1b2838', spaceAfter=6, alignment=TA_CENTER, fontName='Helvetica-Bold' ) subtitle_style = ParagraphStyle( 'CustomSubtitle', parent=styles['Normal'], fontSize=12, textColor='#666666', spaceAfter=30, alignment=TA_CENTER, fontName='Helvetica' ) heading_style = ParagraphStyle( 'CustomHeading', parent=styles['Heading2'], fontSize=16, textColor='#1b2838', spaceAfter=12, spaceBefore=20, fontName='Helvetica-Bold' ) game_title_style = ParagraphStyle( 'GameTitle', parent=styles['Heading3'], fontSize=14, textColor='#1b6fa8', spaceAfter=8, spaceBefore=16, fontName='Helvetica-Bold' ) body_style = ParagraphStyle( 'CustomBody', parent=styles['BodyText'], fontSize=11, textColor='#000000', spaceAfter=12, alignment=TA_JUSTIFY, fontName='Helvetica', leading=14 ) # Build PDF content story = [] # Title story.append(Paragraph("Steam Game Awards Report", title_style)) story.append(Paragraph(f"Generated on {formatted_datetime}", subtitle_style)) story.append(Spacer(1, 0.3*inch)) # Section 1: Steam Awards Overview story.append(Paragraph("Current Steam Game Awards", heading_style)) awards_paragraphs = awards_response.split('\n\n') for para in awards_paragraphs: if para.strip(): story.append(Paragraph(para.strip(), body_style)) story.append(Spacer(1, 0.1*inch)) story.append(Spacer(1, 0.3*inch)) # Section 2: Top 3 Game Recommendations story.append(Paragraph("Top 3 Game Recommendations for December", heading_style)) story.append(Paragraph( "These games are recommended for purchase and play during December based on their Steam Awards recognition, " "gameplay features, and suitability for holiday gaming.", body_style )) story.append(Spacer(1, 0.2*inch)) # Add each game recommendation for i, game in enumerate(games, 1): story.append(Paragraph(f"{i}. {game.get('title', 'Unknown Game')}", game_title_style)) # Awards information story.append(Paragraph(f"Awards & Recognition: {game.get('awards_info', 'N/A')}", body_style)) # December purchase advice story.append(Paragraph(f"Why Buy for December: {game.get('december_advice', 'N/A')}", body_style)) if i < len(games): story.append(Spacer(1, 0.2*inch)) # Footer story.append(Spacer(1, 0.5*inch)) story.append(Paragraph( f"Report generated automatically on {formatted_datetime}", ParagraphStyle('Footer', parent=styles['Normal'], fontSize=9, textColor='#999999', alignment=TA_CENTER) )) # Build PDF print(f"💾 Saving PDF to {output_path}...") doc.build(story) print(f"✅ PDF report saved successfully!") # Save metadata print("\n📊 Saving metadata...") learnings_dir = Path(os.environ.get('RAVL_LEARNINGS_DIR', '.')) metadata_dir = learnings_dir / 'state' metadata_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) metadata_path = metadata_dir / 'metadata.json' metadata = { 'timestamp': current_datetime.isoformat(), 'report_filename': output_filename, 'report_path': str(output_path), 'record_count': len(games), 'games': [{'name': game.get('title', 'Unknown'), 'title': game.get('title', 'Unknown')} for game in games], 'data_changed': True } with open(metadata_path, 'w') as f: json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2) print(f"✅ Metadata saved to {metadata_path}") print("\n🎉 Steam Game Awards Report generation complete!") print(f"📂 Report location: {output_path}")
